comments.text: The Sunday before Katrina hit, the company I worked for sent me (and I took my family) to Ft. Worth where we had a stand-by site to run the business. I was 1200 miles away in New York, but I can vaguely remember seeing the news reports and becoming afraid that a catastrophic storm could hit us too. 7 years later, we were hit by Superstorm Sandy. Her grandmother drowned, and she was left with PTSD and a gash on her face from debris that became a permanent scar. She has lived in my imagination, growing with me, for nearly 15 years (she's 31 now in real time- she has 3 kids and works for her dad's real estate company).
